items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: The Kathrine Dunham dancers were there and then Fats Waller came in with his band.

ctx.x: They were just doing one nighters. Gene had just finished working and I replaced Gene Krupa with my small band. And he played in an Upstairs Room and Jimmy Dorsey was in the Old Town Room and I was in the Panther Room. And MCing the show.

The Kathrine Dunham dancers were there and then Fats Waller came in with his band. But he just did the show. I was the MC and I was the show band. I played for the dancers and the and the comedians and what do you call them, the tricks, the guys that do the tricks?
